title: AOK idea seed
description: Seed: a useful idea not yet put to work (feature ⑤, plan §3⑤). Seeds live in knowledge/seeds.yaml under the top-level `seeds` list (see #/$defs/seeds_file); the curator re-examines the top 3 each round. The root schema validates a single seed.

idea.description: The idea in one or two sentences.

origin.description: Where the idea came from (a plan section, a report, a card id). In this public repo use generic references only, no session ids.

value_hypothesis.description: Why it might be worth it, as a falsifiable hypothesis.

cheapest_experiment.description: The cheapest experiment that would confirm or refute the hypothesis.

est_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost of the cheapest experiment in USD ([추론] unless measured).

revisit_by.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the seed should be re-examined.
